opener_concept: Two block shapes side by side, five rows each. The student counts the bottom row of each (5 vs 3) and says how many more, purely by counting. The reveal names it: each row is an age group, the bottom row is the youngest, and the width of a row is how many people are in it.
notes: No image problems in this lesson (6 Chart.js pyramids, no R2 images), so nothing was flagged as unverifiable on map grounds. All 6 charts preserved byte-for-byte; no chart or image added, removed or altered.
